idea: Lead-lag after sharp BTC (or top-5 basket) moves on Binance USDT perps: trade alts by their beta-adjusted gap to the leader's move. Primary (DEV-selected): after a sharp BTC DOWN hour, buy the 5 alts that overshot BTC most (beta-adjusted) and hold 4h. Secondary (literal catch-up hypothesis): after a sharp top-5-basket UP hour, buy the 5 laggards and hold 4h.
